site_description: Track your Steam, PlayStation and Xbox achievements in one place, and share your collection.
sync_steam_private: Your Steam profile is private. Set “Game details” to public, then sync again.
sync_steam_achievements_private: Your Steam achievements are private. Set “Game details” to public, then sync again.
sync_psn_private: Your PSN trophies are private. Make them visible to everyone, then sync again.
sync_xbox_relink: Reconnect your Xbox account to sync again.
sync_xbox_expired: Your Xbox authorization has expired. Reconnect your account.
home_no_account_text: Link Steam, PlayStation or Xbox: your library and achievements will be imported automatically.
hero_text: Connect your accounts: your Steam, PlayStation and Xbox progress syncs on its own. Every game completed to 100% becomes a gold card to collect.
live_empty: No cards yet. The first one might be yours.
games_empty_text: Link Steam, PlayStation or Xbox to import your library.
achievement_hidden_text: Earn this achievement to reveal its description.
report_prompt: Why are you reporting this content?
report_failed: The report could not be sent.
report_reason_missing: Please give a reason for your report.
guides_empty_text: The team is preparing its guides: this one will come later. You can already share tips in the discussion.
guides_masked_text: Reveal this achievement to read its guide.
guide_forbidden: Only the team can publish a guide.
too_fast: Wait a minute before posting again.
signin_tagline: No password. Every account you link opens the same profile.
signin_none: No sign-in method is configured on this server.
signin_psn_note: PlayStation is linked from your account once you are signed in.
signin_expired: The sign-in request expired. Try again.
signin_refused: The provider did not confirm your identity.
signin_provider_down: The provider cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
signin_unavailable: This sign-in method is not enabled yet.
account_welcome: Welcome! Your sync is starting. Your name comes from your account: you can change it below, and link other accounts.
merge_text: This account already belongs to the profile {name} (@{handle}): {providers}, {games}, {guides}, {comments}.
merge_conflict: Both profiles have a {providers} account. Unlink it from this profile before merging.
merge_warning: Everything will move to the current profile, then @{handle} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
merge_done: Profiles merged. All your accounts now open this profile.
merge_stale: This merge request is no longer valid. Link the account again.
merge_busy: A sync is running. Try again when it has finished.
merge_blocked: Both profiles have an account of the same type. Unlink it before merging.
profile_handle_help: Your profile is at /u/{handle}. If you change it, old links will stop working.
profile_name_short: Your name must be at least 2 characters long.
profile_name_long: Your name must be at most 32 characters long.
profile_name_invalid: Your name contains characters that are not allowed.
profile_handle_invalid: Your username must be 3 to 24 characters: letters, numbers and hyphens.
profile_avatar_unknown: This image does not come from your linked accounts.
psn_instructions: Add this code to the bio of {name}, from your console or the PlayStation app, then verify:
psn_public_note: Your trophies must also be visible to everyone. You can remove the code afterwards.
psn_id_invalid: This PSN ID is not valid.
psn_down: PlayStation Network is not responding. Try again later.
psn_not_found: No PSN profile with this name.
psn_code_expired: The code has expired. Start the linking again.
psn_changed: This PSN profile has changed. Start the linking again.
psn_code_missing: The code {code} does not appear in your PSN bio yet.
psn_other_profile: This PlayStation account belongs to another of your profiles.
psn_linked: PlayStation account linked. You can remove the code from your bio.
public_profile_text: Your profile and achievements are visible to everyone and appear in the ranking.
adult_text: Steam games rated “Frequent Nudity or Sexual Content” or “Adult Only Sexual Content” are hidden by default.
delete_account_label: To permanently delete your account, type “{handle}”
friends_empty_text: Add a player by handle, or from their profile.
clan_none_text: Create yours, or accept a friend's invitation.
clan_already: You are already in a clan.
chat_none_text: Write to a friend from the Friends page.
privacy_data_social: Your friends, clans and blocks, and your messages, kept for one year. Messages are not end-to-end encrypted: moderators only read reported ones.
merge_clan_choice: You are in two clans: choose which to keep.
push_help: Get alerts on this device, even with the site closed. Nothing is sent while you are looking at the site, and a conversation only alerts once every 10 minutes.
push_unsupported: Notifications are not available in this browser. On iPhone, add the site to your Home Screen first.
push_friend_request: wants to add you as a friend.
push_season_open: The season is open. Your abandoned games are waiting.
push_season_closing: Only 3 days left to finish your games.
privacy_data_push: If you enable them, your browser's notification address. Content goes, encrypted, through your browser's notification service. Signing out stops delivery.
push_prompt_text: A friend's message, a call from your clan, an event starting: get told on this device, even with the site closed. No spam, promised.
refresh_wait: Your accounts were just read: try again in a few minutes.
sync_wait: A sync is running. Try again when it has finished.
keep_one_login: Keep at least one Steam, Discord, Xbox or Google account: you use it to sign in.
account_unlinked: Account unlinked, its data was removed from your profile.
provider_taken: An account of this type is already linked. Unlink it to link another one.
profile_empty_mine: Link a game account to fill your profile.
compare_not_found: One of these profiles cannot be found or is private.
community_description: Ranking and latest achievements from the community.
activity_empty_text: Achievements from public profiles will appear here.
profile_not_found: This profile cannot be found or is private.
mod_groups_text: Versions of a game are grouped by title. Separate two different games with the same name, or group two versions whose titles differ.
mod_game_missing: One of these games cannot be found.
privacy_intro: Project Achievers is an independent website. For any question about your data:
privacy_data_accounts: ID, username and avatar of your Steam, Discord, Google, PlayStation and Xbox accounts.
privacy_data_content: Your guides, comments, votes and reports.
privacy_data_sessions: Your sessions: date of use and browser.
privacy_not_collected_text: No platform passwords, and no player NPSSO tokens. Xbox tokens are encrypted on the server. The only cookies are those for your session, language, theme and the sign-in or profile merge steps, which are strictly necessary for the service.
privacy_rights_text: From your account, you can make your profile private, unlink an account, export your data or permanently delete your account.
rate_limited: Too many requests, try again in a minute.
privacy_translation_text: Public guides and comments are sent to Cloudflare Workers AI to be translated automatically into their readers' language. The translation is stored on the site and deleted along with the original text.
ranking_rules: Collection cards make the ranking: Gold 100 points, Platinum 300, Prismatic 900 and Legendary 2,700.
frame_unknown: You do not have this frame yet.
frame_podium_how: Reach this place in the ranking
tagline_1: For once in your life, you're going to finish something.
tagline_2: Your games are dying at {percent}%. Finish them.
tagline_3: You own {games} games. You finished {finished}. Doing okay?
tagline_4: Your library isn't a collection. It's a graveyard.
tagline_5: That game at {percent}% is watching you. It knows.
tagline_6: You didn't quit. You'll "get back to it later". Sure.
tagline_7: You always catch the end of a sale. Never the end of a game.
tagline_8: You walked away from the final boss. It's still waiting.
tagline_9: We finished the site. Your turn.
banner_frames_text: Earn frames and show them everywhere on the site.
tagline_10: You didn't finish this game. Just like everything else.
tagline_12: Your games stopped waiting. They've moved on.
tagline_16: Still {game} at {percent}%. You're making progress. No.
tagline_17: Your play history embarrasses you. Us too.
tagline_18: You said "I'll finish it this weekend". That was in 2019.
tagline_20: {minutes} minutes on {game}. And you dare say you tried it.
showcase_edit_help: Choose the cards shown on your profile, up to {max}.
showcase_full: Your showcase is full: {max} cards maximum.
showcase_none_help: Your best cards stay visible while your selection is empty.
showcase_not_owned: You do not have this card.
showcase_mode_best_help: Your profile automatically shows your best cards.
season_intro: For once in your life, you're going to finish something. Complete the games you started, earn points and win exclusive rewards.
season_goal_text: Let's finish {goal} achievements together. If we make it, every participant earns an exclusive frame.
season_reward_3: An animated frame and a title
season_rule_common: Achievement earned by over 50% of players
season_rule_uncommon: Achievement earned by 20 to 50% of players
season_rule_rare: Achievement earned by 5 to 20% of players
season_rule_epic: Achievement earned by under 5% of players
season_rule_complete: Game completed to 100% during the season
season_rules_text: Only games started before the season count. Achievements unlocked in a burst earn nothing, nor does the bonus for a game they finish.
season_ignored: Achievements not counted in the season: {count}
season_badge_help: This game counts for the Finish them season.
season_game_counts: This game counts for the season.
season_game_soon: Does not count yet: earn an achievement before {date} to make it count for the season.
season_game_no: Does not count for the season: it had to be started before it opened.
